name: Liftoff
tagline: A pre-launch checklist bot for anyone shipping an app, site, or paid plan.
description: A pre-launch checklist bot for anyone shipping an app, site, or paid plan. It checks the happy path and the failure path, data access rules, leaked keys, rate limits, OWASP issues, payments, privacy, and email. Then it gives a GO, GO-WITH-FIXES, or NO-GO call, with evidence for every line.
author: the_Arow_H
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
